name: ui-runtime-drag
description: Drag Play Mode runtime UI from a start screen position to an end position or delta. Tries uGUI and UI Toolkit at the same bottom-left-origin coordinates used by ui-control-find. Requires Play Mode.

framework.description: Framework scope. all/auto (default) tries uGUI and UI Toolkit; ugui/uitoolkit force one.

x.description: Drag start screen x in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

y.description: Drag start screen y in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

toX.description: Drag end screen x in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

toY.description: Drag end screen y in pixels, or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

deltaX.description: Drag delta x in pixels, or normalized width fraction when isNormalized is true. Alternative to toX/toY.

deltaY.description: Drag delta y in pixels, or normalized height fraction when isNormalized is true. Alternative to toX/toY.

isNormalized.description: When true, x/y/toX/toY/deltaX/deltaY use normalized bottom-left coordinates.

path.description: uGUI GameObject transform path, UI Toolkit VisualElement path, or visualElementRef (ve:...) from runtime reads/probes.
